title: Google-backed Indian space startup raises $100 million in latest funding round
title_zh: 谷歌支持的印度太空初创公司在最新一轮融资中筹集了 1 亿美元
summary: Sept 7 (Reuters) - Indian space tech startup Pixxel said on Monday it had raised $100 million in a Series C funding round led by Singapore state investor Temasek and British space-technology venture
summary_zh: 路透 9 月 7 日 - 印度太空科技初创公司 Pixxel 周一表示，已在由新加坡国家投资者淡马锡和英国太空技术企业领投的 C 轮融资中筹集了 1 亿美元

title: Why Nvidia wants Hugging Face to keep helping its rivals: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 为什么 Nvidia 希望 Hugging Face 继续帮助其竞争对手：每日图表
summary: Nvidia got rich selling scarcity in AI — now it's betting on AI abundance.
summary_zh: 英伟达通过销售人工智能的稀缺性而发了财，现在它把赌注押在了人工智能的丰富性上。

title: Inflation data, Oracle earnings, and an energy supply crunch: What to watch this week
title_zh: 通胀数据、甲骨文财报和能源供应紧缩：本周值得关注的内容
summary: Two questions are set to lead the week: Will the data push the Fed toward a rate hike, and what can Oracle tell Wall Street about the state of Big Tech's AI debt load?
summary_zh: 本周将围绕两个问题：该数据是否会推动美联储加息，以及甲骨文可以告诉华尔街有关大型科技公司人工智能债务负担状况的哪些信息？
